speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for Transport (a) for each year over the past five years, how many instances have occurred of MRT or LRT trains (i) undergoing irregular and sudden acceleration and (ii) train doors closing without warning; and (b) whether there is any mechanism for collating data on such incidents if they are not reported by commuters.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Just one supplementary question: will the Ministry consider publishing such data at regular intervals in future as a key performance indicator of the performance of the system in this regard?

speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
text: The Ministry of Transport publishes different sets of data.

speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
text: We are upgrading our train systems, as the Member well knows.

speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
text: This will up the reliability and the commuter experiences.
